configuration_selection_criterion: Required-answer schema completion and deployment availability only; forecast accuracy was not evaluated.

deployment_selection.reason: No Pro-tier Gemini deployment can serve the 3,750-call design on this project. gemini-3.1-pro-preview and its gemini-pro-latest alias share a 250 requests/day cap that the paid billing tier does not lift, and gemini-2.5-pro returns NotFoundError under every name form. gemini-3.6-flash (3.6-flash-07-2026) is the newest generally available Gemini text deployment on the key and accepted 40 simultaneous requests in 2.5 seconds.

rejected.reason: generate_requests_per_model_per_day limit 250, unchanged after enabling billing
NotFoundError for every name form on this key

deployment_selection.tier_note: Gemini 3.6 Flash is Google's fast tier, not its Pro tier. It is newer than every other deployment in this comparison but is not tier-matched to Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, or Kimi K3.

deployment_smoke_calls.purpose: Throughput and availability probes across candidate deployments, using a trivial non-experimental prompt.
